title: Hearty Broiled Slovakian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring lamb, coriander seeds, and a blend of spices, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot. This paleo-friendly recipe is perfect for a lazy Sunday dinner.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground coriander seeds, paprika, salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
In a large tagine pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the coriander seed mixture over the lamb and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated broiler.
Broil the lamb for 20 minutes, then reduce the heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue cooking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
